name: Expressionism
summary: Early-20th-century Expressionism as cloth: a near-black ground over deep blue, blood-red and acid-yellow emotional color, condensed display type, and wavy distorted brushstroke edges that make the whole surface feel strained.
whenToUse: When the user asks for Expressionism, Munch or Die Brücke, an anguished painterly aesthetic, emotional distortion, woodcut roughness, non-naturalistic color, or a tense art-historical skin for an editorial, cultural, or mental-health-adjacent product.
rules: Color is feeling, not description: never use a calm or naturalistic fill — a sky is blood red, a road is acid yellow, skin is deep blue — and let exactly two emotional colors collide per screen (blood #b22222 against acid #e6c229 on the deep blue field) while everything structural stays #14141a or #e8e4dc.

Distort the edge, not the grid: container edges are drawn with an SVG turbulence/clip-path wave (feTurbulence baseFrequency .012–.03, 2–4px amplitude) or a hand-torn 2px stroke, but text baselines, columns, and tap targets stay on the 4px grid so anxiety reads as style and never as broken layout.

Keep the ground dark and the light hot: page background is near-black #14141a, panels are deep blue #1b2a4a, and the only bright values are bone #e8e4dc text and acid #e6c229 accents — no light or pastel page backgrounds, ever.

Set display type in Oswald 700 / Archivo Black uppercase with negative tracking (-0.01em to -0.02em) and slight per-line offsets (±1–2px translate, alternate skew of -0.6deg/0.4deg) so headings look pressed by hand; body copy stays upright, unstretched, and legible.

Shadows are smeared, not lit: use the 8px 8px 0 #14141a hard offset for lifted panels and the -6px 4px 18px rgba(20,20,26,.55) smear for focus surfaces; never add a neon glow, glass blur, or gradient bevel.
Heavy anxious vignette is part of the frame (radial gradient closing to #14141a at the corners) and applies to the page shell only — never over body text, form values, or any interactive target.

Motion is tense and brief: 90–180ms with cubic-bezier(.36,-.07,.64,1.37) overshoot, occasional 1–2px jitter on hover, no long crossfades, and no looping tremor anywhere; under prefers-reduced-motion every jitter, skew, and entrance collapse to 0ms with no motion.

No artwork: expressionist feeling comes from palette pressure, brushstroke edges, condensed woodcut type, and collision — never from a painting, print, or brush texture file lifted from Munch or Die Brücke.

componentRecipes.table: A strained grid: header = Oswald 700 13px uppercase #e8e4dc over a 3px #b22222 rule that wavers ±2px; body rows = IBM Plex Mono 15px #e8e4dc separated by 1px #9aa3b8 rules; hover = #e6c229 text, selected row = #b22222 fill with a 3px #e6c229 left band; numerals in tabular mono, radius 2px.

componentRecipes.empty: A centred panel: a rough brushstroke glyph (a torn band) above one Plex Mono message ('This will not hold. It is empty.') and a single blood CTA; the glyph is aria-hidden and the state is written in words.

copywriting.voice: An anguished first-person voice that speaks in short, pressured, present-tense lines — the interface is not describing software, it is enduring it. Copy names the feeling and the fact in the same breath ('The night is loud. I cannot close it.'), prefers concrete nouns over abstractions, and never softens the sentence with a smile. It is never cruel to the user: the anguish belongs to the surface and the sky, never to a person who mistyped a field.

case.headers: UPPERCASE, Oswald or Archivo Black, often two words or fewer
case.commands: sentence case imperative, short and hot ('Hold it', 'Say it plain', 'Stop the noise')
case.body: sentence case, short lines, no exclamation stacking

avoid: emoji, exclamation stacks, and all-caps sentences over three words
clinical or diagnostic language about the reader's mental state
shaming error copy ('Invalid input.', 'Wrong.') and self-deprecating product jokes
naming or quoting a real painting, or reproducing its title as a decoration

do: Let exactly two emotional colors collide per screen — blood #b22222 against acid #e6c229 over the deep blue #1b2a4a field — and keep every structural element on #14141a or #e8e4dc.
Distort edges with feTurbulence clip-paths, torn 2px strokes, and ±2px wavering rules while leaving text baselines, columns, and hit areas perfectly straight.
Set headings in Oswald 700 or Archivo Black uppercase with slight negative tracking and a per-line offset of ±1–2px so type looks pressed by hand.
Keep the heavy vignette on the page shell only, so the corners close in without ever dimming body copy or a focus ring.
Animate in 90–180ms bursts with one overshoot, add a 1–2px hover jitter at most, and stop everything dead under prefers-reduced-motion.
Compose with asymmetry: an off-centre column, a tall narrow band of color, a low horizon line — imbalance carried by the layout, never by broken alignment.
dont: No artworks: never embed, trace, crop, or imitate a Munch or Die Brücke painting, print, or brush texture file — the evocation lives in palette, edge, and type only.
No scanlines, no pixelation, no CRT effects, no glassmorphism, no neon glow, and no smooth gradient bevels; roughness comes from edges and smear shadow.
No pastel, cream, or white page backgrounds — the ground stays near-black #14141a with #1b2a4a panels.
No wavy, skewed, or rotated body text: distortion is structural decoration, and any paragraph, form value, or table cell stays upright.
No looping tremor, pulsing, or infinite jitter animations, and no motion that ignores prefers-reduced-motion.
No third or fourth emotional color mixed into one component as decoration, and no mood-coded color as the only signal of state.
accessibility: Bone #e8e4dc on #14141a and on #1b2a4a both clear 4.5:1; blood #b22222 and acid #e6c229 on the dark grounds do not — use them for fills, bands, borders, and large bold type only, and set text inside a red fill in bone rather than in black.

Oswald and Archivo Black condensed faces stay at 17px minimum with 1.2–1.3 line-height and short lines, and never carry paragraphs; IBM Plex Mono handles every running sentence, form value, and table cell at 15px/1.55 minimum.
Honour prefers-reduced-motion: remove the hover jitter, the type skew and per-line offsets, the toggle wobble, and all 90–180ms overshoot, presenting state changes instantly with no motion at all.

Never encode state in red or acid alone — pair every band, dot, and border with a word ('Unresolved', 'Failed', 'Settled', 'Open'/'Shut') and keep a visible 3px #e6c229 focus ring on every focusable element, drawn on a straight edge so it cannot be mistaken for decoration.
The vignette must never sit above content: keep it in the page shell with pointer-events: none and a hard floor on its inner transparency so contrast measured at the corners still passes.
signatureElement: The wavy, hand-distorted brushstroke band: a torn 2–3px edge (feTurbulence clip-path or wavering rule) that carries blood red into acid yellow across the deep blue field and quivers along section boundaries while the type inside stays straight

prose.overview: This mode dresses the interface in early-twentieth-century Expressionism: a near-black ground, deep blue panels, and blood red colliding with acid yellow until the surface feels strained rather than calm. Everything structural stays on a strict grid, and the anxiety is carried by palette pressure, torn brushstroke edges, condensed woodcut display type, and a heavy closing vignette. It is meant for editorial, cultural, and interior-facing work that can bear an uncomfortable mood, not for a checkout flow. The feeling is Munch and Die Brücke, but the execution is clean CSS — distortion at the border, order in the content.
prose.colors: The ground is near-black #14141a with panels one step up in deep blue #1b2a4a, bone #e8e4dc carries text, and #9aa3b8 is the only muted tone. Feeling is carried by two colliding colors: blood red #b22222 for primary action, left-edge bands, and heat, acid yellow #e6c229 for accent, focus rings, and the sharp high note, with #c0392b for danger, #4f7a6f for the rare settled success, and #2e4468 as the shading step inside panels. Nothing is naturalistic — a sky is red, a road is yellow — and the emotional ramps give each hue a light/base/dark triad so pressed and disabled states stay inside the same family instead of sliding toward grey.
prose.typography: Oswald 700 leads, with Archivo Black and Anton as the heavier fallbacks, set uppercase in one- or two-word headings from 26px up with slightly negative tracking and a per-line offset of a pixel or two so the stack looks pressed by hand. Body copy never joins the distortion: it sits upright in IBM Plex Mono at 15px/1.55, which is what keeps a tense skin usable at length and gives numbers and labels a woodcut, letterpress feel. There is no italic fakery and no letter-spacing past 0.04em, because the tension is meant to come from weight, color, and edge rather than from shredded tracking.
prose.layout: Layout is asymmetric but rigid: a 4px-derived spacing scale stepping 5/11/19/31/47px, a twelve-column grid, and compositions built from imbalance — an off-centre column, a tall narrow color band, a low horizon line pushing the eye upward. The asymmetry lives in the macro composition, while every baseline, column edge, and tap target snaps to the grid so nothing feels broken, only weighted. Wavy brushstroke boundaries move between sections and take the tremor; content blocks behind them stay square.
prose.elevation: Depth is smeared rather than lit: an 8px 8px 0 #14141a hard offset for lifted panels and a -6px 4px 18px rgba(20,20,26,.55) side smear for focus surfaces, both landing off-axis so the light feels wrong on purpose. The heavy radial vignette closes the corners from 18% transparency to near-black and belongs to the page shell only, never over text. There is no neon glow, no glass blur, and no gradient bevel — the only bright ring in the system is the 3px acid #e6c229 focus outline, which is drawn on a straight edge so it can never be mistaken for brushwork.
prose.shapes: Shapes are near-square — radius 2px — with edges that read as cut or torn rather than drawn: an SVG feTurbulence clip-path at 2–4px amplitude or a hand-sketch 2px stroke, plus rules and underlines that visibly waver ±2px. Bands of color run tall and narrow with torn lower ends, and the occasional 1–2px per-line offset in display type repeats that tremble at the typographic level. Perfect circles, glassy translucency, and pixel-perfect pixel art have no place here; circles appear only as rough strokes that fail to close.
prose.components: Panels are deep blue #1b2a4a on near-black with a 2px #14141a stroke, a torn clip-path edge, an 8px hard shadow, and a red band down the left side; their headings are Oswald uppercase with a wavering acid underline. Buttons are blood-red plates rotated fractionally, pressing moves them into their own shadow, and the secondary keeps a bone stroke on the blue field. Inputs are near-black mono wells that shift to a hot border and an acid focus ring, toggles are woodcut switches with a red knob and an acid score line that shortens as it travels, and the status bar is a mono line of state notes with a deliberately wavering top border and one blood-red action on the right.
prose.dosDonts: Do let two emotional colors collide per screen, do distort the border and keep the text straight, do keep the ground near-black with blue panels, and do stop every jitter under prefers-reduced-motion. Don't reproduce or imitate any actual painting or print, don't scanline or pixelate the surface, don't set a paragraph in a skewed condensed face, don't encode state in red alone, and don't let the vignette sit over content.
